subject.title: fix(repair): publish only validated target commits

question: Should the repair lane permanently require Linux delegated user/mount/network/PID namespaces with Landlock ABI 3+ and fail closed on runners that cannot provide that boundary?
rationale: This deliberately trades compatibility and repair availability for a stronger credential-publication boundary; repository intent is required to determine whether that is the supported permanent runner contract.

options.title: Accept after exact-head proof
options.body: Adopt the Linux-only fail-closed contract after the current ad4a270 head passes the same redacted hosted containment and publication scenarios documented for e65ec156.

options.title: Preserve a compatibility mode
options.body: Keep existing runners usable through an explicit non-publication or reduced-trust mode, with credentials and branch publication unavailable outside the hardened boundary.

options.title: Split the landing
options.body: Land immutable validated-SHA publication separately and pause the broader namespace and package-manager containment redesign for a narrower follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Adopt the Linux-only fail-closed contract after the current ad4a270 head passes the same redacted hosted containment and publication scenarios documented for e65ec156.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the predecessor and current repair-hardening implementation and are best positioned to explain the intended runner and security contract.
